tagline: A launch-night companion for GTA VI. Track what you find, see what is confirmed.
nav.label: Main
hub.buyBody: Digital editions unlock at midnight CET on 19 November on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. The standard digital edition is {standard}. There is no PC version at launch.
guides.heading: Guides
guides.inEnglish: This guide is only in English so far.
footer.disclaimer: Unofficial fan project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.
notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: That address does not exist. Pick a language to start over.
install.title: Install Rookdex
install.body: Add it to your home screen so it opens like an app and works offline.
tracker.title: Tracker
tracker.description: Tick off wildlife, vehicles, places and collectibles as you find them. Works offline and stays on your device.
tracker.needsJs: The tracker needs JavaScript. Your progress is stored on this device only.
tracker.storageError: Your browser is blocking local storage, so progress cannot be saved here.
tracker.persistHint: This browser may clear saved progress after a week without a visit. Install Rookdex or export your profile to keep it safe.
tracker.errors.too-large: That file is larger than 5 MB.
tracker.errors.not-export: This isn't a Rookdex export file.
tracker.errors.storage: Saving failed. Your browser may be blocking storage.
tracker.errors.name: Give the profile a name of 1 to 40 characters.
tracker.errors.closed: Your data changed in another tab. Reload to continue.
profile.deleteBody: You can restore it from Deleted profiles for 30 days. After that it is gone.
profile.importBody: Newer ticks win. Nothing already in {into} is removed.
rumours.title: Rumours
rumours.intro: Reported by press, not confirmed by Rockstar. Rumours move to the tracker when confirmed.
news.title: News
news.description: News about GTA VI, including what the press reports that Rockstar has not confirmed.
sources.title: Sources
sources.lede: Where every item in the tracker comes from.
sources.back: Back to the item in the tracker
settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Language, the data Rookdex keeps on this device, and app details.
settings.dangerBody: Removes every profile, all progress and your language choice on this device. It can't be undone. Export first if you want a copy.
settings.deleteAll: Delete all data on this device
settings.dialogTitle: Delete all data on this device?
settings.done: All data on this device is deleted.
settings.blocked: Close other Rookdex tabs to finish.
settings.failed: Something went wrong. Nothing was deleted.
settings.iosHowTo: Share, then Add to Home Screen
settings.trademarks: All trademarks belong to their owners.
settings.keepsChoices: Your choices about the install prompt and hints stay, so they do not return.
